node.statement: For the data chosen in 1.1, every stochastic idempotent F on l-infinity(4) satisfies ||Q_lambda-F||_{infinity->infinity}>=lambda=sqrt(eta_lambda/2). This is exactly the distance conclusion of the external lem-prh-sharpness, namely ||A_lambda M_lambda-F||>=lambda=sqrt(epsilon_lambda/2), after the definitional substitutions Q_lambda=A_lambda M_lambda and eta_lambda=epsilon_lambda from 1.1.
